title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Page 117-2]

items.text: Are fighters hiding in eastern Afghanistan?
Aren't you seeing a clearer picture?
More than forty more were wounded, weren't they?
Are journalists covering the war in Afghanistan?.
Didn't they receive a credible threat?
Non-Afghan journalists could be kidnapped, couldn't they?
Why did journalists immediately assess their security arrangements?
They were taking extra precautions, weren't they?
Isn't the threat their way of retaliating(retaliation)?
When did the remains of seven servicemen return home?
Didn't they arrive at the air force base?
The servicemen(soldiers) died in two separate incidents, didn't they?
Most were not killed in a fierce firefight with Taliban forces, were they?
How did the navy petty officer fall out of his helicopter?
Wasn't he then dragged away by Al Qaeda fighters?
Is the recovery effort destroying vital clues?
Why did the twin towers collapse?
